name: AI Upscaler Plugin
overview: AI-Powered Video Upscaling Plugin with Docker Microservice Architecture
description: Video upscaling through an external AI service, with client-side scaling and optional object masking. Backend and model availability depend on the installed image and hardware. HDR processing is limited to single PQ/BT.2020 RGB16 frames; target-hardware validation is required.
changelog: v1.8.3.34: Real-time upscaling starts again in the web client. Since v1.8.3.31 it refused every video with "Video color metadata unavailable", because Jellyfin 10.9 and later no longer put the playing item in the page address; the player now reads the item from the video's stream or the web client's playback request and checks the version that plays. Requires Jellyfin 12.0 or newer. Target-hardware playback, GPU and HDR acceptance remain unverified.
